scenarios.title: Independent inbox task
scenarios.initial: No task t1 and today daily note may not exist.
scenarios.action: Create task from All Tasks; read/open returned task.
scenarios.expected: One TaskId/one inbox placement, empty/default body, no daily note auto-create; page and Tasks row reference same identity.

scenarios.title: Task body one owner
scenarios.initial: t1 has placement in n1 and one body Budget details; two views open it.
scenarios.action: Append X to task-page body through core.
scenarios.expected: Both task-page views see Budget detailsX at returned revision; owning note/Tasks resolve same t1, no second note/body or placement.

scenarios.title: Atomic task move
scenarios.initial: t1 placed in n1; n2 destination/current guards read.
scenarios.action: Move to n2 then inspect both sources.
scenarios.expected: Only n2 owns t1; title/body/custom/standard fields and history preserved; no intermediate accepted state with two/no active placements.

scenarios.title: Copy task independence
scenarios.initial: t1 active in n1, body B/custom C.
scenarios.action: Copy into n2 then complete copied task.
scenarios.expected: Fresh independent task/owned identities with B/C; completing copy leaves t1 unchanged; no user reference reuse. Series mapping is conditional M-05.

scenarios.title: Retry before stale guard
scenarios.initial: Move op k succeeds with source/destination old revisions; response lost.
scenarios.action: Retry identical op k after revisions advanced.
scenarios.expected: Return original result/identity map or pending status without evaluating old guard as a new mutation and without moving again. Current authorization still required.

scenarios.title: ID reused for changed intent
scenarios.initial: Operation k previously moved t1 to n2.
scenarios.action: Send k with destination n3.
scenarios.expected: OPERATION_ID_REUSED, no mutation; do not return successful result for the changed request.

scenarios.title: Concurrent duplicate admission
scenarios.initial: No recorded operation k; two local clients submit identical k concurrently.
scenarios.action: Race authority admission/reservation.
scenarios.expected: At most one new task/placement; both observe same eventual outcome/IDs. Duplicate reservation cannot race validation/write.

scenarios.title: Expired dedup record
scenarios.initial: Old accepted identity has compacted body/outcome under selected R04 retention protocol.
scenarios.action: Inspect/retry old identity outside supported lease/window.
scenarios.expected: Explicit expired/unknown plus reconciliation path; never execute old accepted intent again just because a detailed outcome is absent.

scenarios.title: Stale local replace rejected
scenarios.initial: AI plan prepared at note r1; user edits produce r2.
scenarios.action: Commit old plan, claiming latest-wins provider policy.
scenarios.expected: PRECONDITION_FAILED/plan conflict; r2 untouched. Normal AI capability cannot invoke internal sync bypass.

scenarios.title: Property independence and fixed columns
scenarios.initial: Notes a/b each own a property labelled Status with independent definitions.
scenarios.action: Change a option/value; query predefined collection.
scenarios.expected: b unchanged; no new dynamic columns or auto-written properties; standard field names cannot alias custom data.

scenarios.title: Task deletion and restore
scenarios.initial: t1 has body/fields and sole n1 placement.
scenarios.action: Delete whole placement, then guarded restore.
scenarios.expected: Task leaves active views, not silently moved to inbox. Recovery/restore can recover same identity/body/fields and sole placement when conflicts absent.

scenarios.title: Title edits and visual indentation protect task body/independence
scenarios.initial: Task title selected text but task body B exists.
scenarios.action: Delete selected title text only; in a separately reset variant indent/outdent the task placement.
scenarios.expected: Body B/properties remain; no lifecycle cascade from text emptying. Indentation changes placement presentation only, no parent/subtask status/date/deletion dependency. Empty-title outcome conditional Q-02.

scenarios.title: Note delete effect closure
scenarios.initial: n1 owns t1/t2; unrelated inbox t3 exists.
scenarios.action: Delete n1 then restore from guarded retained closure.
scenarios.expected: n1/t1/t2 active state removed/restored coherently; t3 unaffected. Historical task moved elsewhere causes explicit ownership conflict rather than duplication.

scenarios.title: Pinned historical task body
scenarios.initial: Pinned n1 version references t1 body Old at revision a; current t1 becomes New and moves.
scenarios.action: Read old n1 version and run permitted automatic compaction in later harness.
scenarios.expected: Historical owned task body remains Old; all manifest dependencies/assets retained. Current t1 remains New at current location.

scenarios.title: Stale restore plan with moved task
scenarios.initial: Plan n1 historical restore while t1 at original location; then t1 moves to n2.
scenarios.action: Commit stale plan.
scenarios.expected: Reject/replan ownership/revision conflict; no second t1 placement or hidden relocation. Restore-as-copy is a separate explicit policy.

scenarios.title: Recurrence generation dedup
scenarios.initial: Weekly Monday task t1 pending, then completed Wednesday after missed Monday.
scenarios.action: Retry completion, replay provider state and race separate stale completion.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one next distinct future Monday occurrence, empty body, copied title/properties with temporal adjustments; completed body retained. Reopen/edit/undo remain conditional.

scenarios.title: Presentation does not mutate
scenarios.initial: Date mention stores 2026-11-14 and no reminder; current date advances a day.
scenarios.action: Refresh labels and load media previews.
scenarios.expected: Yesterday label but same semantic revision; no reminder/outbox/history entry solely from rendering or display refresh.

scenarios.title: Conversion failure is not half a move
scenarios.initial: n1 selection beta; force destination creation persistence failure.
scenarios.action: Convert to page.
scenarios.expected: Original content/reference closure protected; no falsely successful dangling page link. Outcome distinguishes rejected/not-committed from uncertainty; retry uses same identity.

scenarios.title: Unknown content preserved
scenarios.initial: Opaque block u1 with asset roots between known text blocks.
scenarios.action: Edit known text, then attempt interchange that cannot represent u1.
scenarios.expected: Known edit preserves opaque payload/roots; unsupported destructive replacement reports loss/refuses according to explicit policy; never silently flattens u1.

scenarios.title: Provider competing placement rejected as incoherent
scenarios.initial: Two received note winner packages both claim same TaskId after concurrent moves.
scenarios.action: Attempt ingestion before required coherent reconciliation unit is resolved.
scenarios.expected: Current state remains valid with at most one task placement; retain received states pending/blocked and history, not blindly apply per-file winners. Provider support blocked until M-06 solved.

scenarios.title: Save/outbox and uncertain completion
scenarios.initial: Local edit accepted; inject interruption around durable state/outcome/outbox write.
scenarios.action: Restart/inspect original operation.
scenarios.expected: No false durable/synced flag; committed work has persistent publication intent, unconfirmed work remains protected/reconcilable, no blind new-ID retry. Exact write protocol R04.

scenarios.title: Access checks on retry and internal commands
scenarios.initial: Local client lacks ingest capability or loses its Space grant after an earlier operation.
scenarios.action: Request internal ingest or inspect sensitive retained result.
scenarios.expected: ACCESS_DENIED without content leakage; operationId/actor string is not authentication and replay does not bypass current authorization.

scenarios.title: Selective inverse protects another context
scenarios.initial: A inserts block, B adds independent content to it.
scenarios.action: A requests original block insertion inverse.
scenarios.expected: Safe selective inverse or explicit conflict/narrowing; never delete B content blindly and report success. No whole-version rewind.

scenarios.title: Comment history closure
scenarios.initial: Retained version contains block b1 plus anchored thread c1.
scenarios.action: Delete b1, then undo or guarded restore of retained content.
scenarios.expected: Thread absent from live page after delete, retained with b1 version and restored with it; not reanchored to unrelated block. Comment feature phase remains unresolved.
